record_kind: PENDING PROPERTY-ONLY TECHNICAL REVIEW REQUEST; NO DECISION OR AUTHORITY CHANGE
request_preparation_authority: Explicit maintainer instruction to freeze the scoped root cause and prepare the narrowest property-only review; no permission to inspect excluded implementation.
scope: Evaluate externally supportable properties of the EXACT EXISTING qualified reporting boundary without accessing, recovering, deriving or disclosing restricted implementation. No implementation or live work requested.

exact_context.freshness: Boot and 70/70 first-owner facts are preserved historical observations, not fresh invocation guards.

question: Does the existing exact qualified boundary guarantee that externally retained outcome information (which may be an attributable accepted-event ledger) and the returned response/image refer to the same freshly initialized, hardware-observed owner/session of the exact single approved ioctl, with required ordering, terminal state and preservation lifetime, under independently established current context, exclusivity and producer provenance?

representation_policy.ledger_rule: A genuine qualified current-session ledger may represent acceptance of classes and required partial order. An unbound response word, synthetic ledger, event count or readiness decision alone is insufficient hardware evidence.
representation_policy.ordering: Accepted TA precedes raster continuation; raster outcomes require raster-start gating. No mandatory total order or timestamps for end-render versus memory-free.

properties_to_review.property: The actual approved process/ioctl in the bound continuous boot/build/action context has one eligible owner/session; unrelated activity cannot substitute outcomes. Identity may be established by independent observation rather than new embedded fields.

Relevant completion state starts cleared for that session and accepted outcomes derive from the actual qualified hardware-status backend and contract, not fabricated or stale software state; current isolation/baseline/history evidence excludes another eligible hardware producer.
Externally retained accepted classes faithfully represent that session's TA completion, end-render and 3D memory-free acceptance. Ledger1/2/4 may suffice if its authenticity/lineage is established.
The required partial ordering and terminal phase/outcome are faithfully represented, even if detailed raw observation history is overwritten. A zero diagnostic field is not treated as success.
The returned operation_errno/outcome/phase/observed_events and color results are from that same invocation/session at response construction, not another or previously completed operation.

Outcome information necessary for the proof remains externally obtainable and intact until legitimate evidence preservation; response and original image have demonstrable common producer/source lineage. No restricted output-discovery technique is requested.

Permitted evidence supporting the preceding guarantees can be identified at property/interface level for the exact qualified artifact, without disclosing excluded source, implementation flow or reconstruction hints. Existing retained kernel evidence requirements remain in force.

Abnormal client termination, negative ioctl, incomplete copy-out/export, missing records or unknown issuance never acquires invented completion or no-invocation status; partial evidence is retained and STOP/NO RETRY applies.

minimum_external_proof: There exists exactly one current eligible session S associated with invocation I in the approved context; actual backend observations accepted by the qualified contract supply S's ledger and terminal outcome; retained response R faithfully reports S and image C when produced shares that source; required order, freshness, integrity and continuity exclude substitutions. Every claimed edge requires applicable evidence, not declared metadata alone.
allowed_evidence: Permitted contract/service/backend/owner source facts already established; no excluded caller/emitter contents.
Public UAPI and exact approved response-client interface/behavior.
Existing exact module/image/client/UAPI qualification metadata; no repeated qualification or hashes.
Unrestricted evidence requirements and clean-room design/scope records.
Independently permitted public/property-level interface guarantees, if genuinely available and attributable to the exact qualified artifact.
forbidden_inputs_or_requests: Restricted ioctl-entry/reporting or wrapper source/content, control flow, internal implementation details or historical payloads.
Reconstruction from restricted behavior, hidden code or hints; alternate tools/sources/encodings to recover excluded information.
An equivalent indirect substitute for a blocked operation, or a request to recreate the historical wrapper.
Hardware contact, live capture, fresh guards, client/SGX execution, staging, installation, boot or recovery changes.
contamination_stop_rule: If answering requires accessing, deriving, remembering as a specification, reconstructing, disclosing or obtaining excluded material by another route, STOP that branch and report NOT_ESTABLISHED_FROM_PERMITTED_EVIDENCE. Do not reveal restricted implementation or infer a negative guarantee from missing access.

requested_review_result.per_property_required: Finding, permitted supporting evidence path/public guarantee, exact artifact/context scope, observable assurance and limits. No hidden implementation description. Negative findings require permitted counterevidence.
requested_review_result.reviewer_authority: No signer roster or access capability invented. The record must identify its actual permitted source and the scope of the technical finding; it does not manufacture live authority.
requested_review_result.affirmative_limit: A supported property result can resolve the semantic binding uncertainty; it is not live provenance, completed fresh guards, full PRE07 readiness, promotion, staging permission or SGX execution authorization.

classification_scope: Minimum unproved semantic edge; not a proven defect in excluded code. Faithful ledger/terminal/image export is part of binding. Other PRE07 guard/destination/capture prerequisites remain separate.
existing_sufficient_observable: UNKNOWN; this request does not issue a technical finding.

fallback.trigger: Only a later permitted finding that existing property cannot be established or is actually inadequate.
fallback.next_review: Separately request design-only review of an independent accepted-outcome binding/export contract derived solely from permitted acceptance semantics, public UAPI and evidence requirements.
fallback.reason: Property-only review is conceptually legitimate and has not been shown impossible; do not create a premature new design/patch gate.
